description: Defines data classes and enums for representing products, cart items, orders, and user profiles in a grocery ordering app.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Data class representing a product in the grocery catalog.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Data class representing a single item added to the cart.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Data class representing a placed order summary.

classes.name: OrderStatus
classes.description: Enum class listing possible order status states.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Data class representing a user profile and authentication state.
